descriptions.offender_age_profile: the ages of the accused across the caseload: the age range, the average age, and how many accused have no age recorded
descriptions.station_caseload_by_specialisation: whether caseload is growing faster at general-purpose police stations or at specialised units such as cybercrime, anti-corruption or women's protection stations, comparing the two kinds of station
descriptions.placeholder_officer_count: how many cases still have no real investigating officer actually assigned, only a placeholder or unnamed officer
descriptions.criminal_record_local_match_gap: people who appear in the wider criminal-history records but have no matching accused record in our own FIRs
descriptions.chalaan_dispatch_count: how many challans, the police report to the court, have been sent to court and how many cases they cover
descriptions.criminal_record_court_crosscheck: how many cases in the criminal record system are completed with a verdict versus still in progress, and whether the criminal record's conviction status agrees with the court's recorded outcome
descriptions.dv_report_fir_match: whether a domestic violence or violence-against-women report that was recorded as converted into a formal case is confirmed by an actual FIR
descriptions.cms_fir_linkage: whether walk-in complaints filed at a police station are linked to a formal FIR or stay separate from the case record
descriptions.court_readiness_scan: preparing a case file for handover to court: which fields a prosecutor or court is most likely to find incomplete before accepting the file
descriptions.fir_register_completeness: whether each FIR register entry carries the details the law requires to be recorded, such as the complainant, the sections and the date
descriptions.case_completeness_scan: which cases have records so incomplete that they might be overlooked or buried: missing incident dates and no diary entries
descriptions.accused_relationship_breakdown: what relationship is recorded between the accused and the complainant or victim, and whether they were strangers or knew each other
descriptions.weapon_compliance_scan: record-keeping compliance for recovered weapons: how many recovered weapons are recorded without a licence
descriptions.weapon_evidence_chain: for a weapon logged as evidence, which FIR it belongs to, which accused it was recovered from, and what happened to that accused
descriptions.seized_property_disposition: what happened to seized property in the malkhana property store: how much was sent to a forensic lab, returned to owners or heirs, or kept
descriptions.arrest_rate: on how many FIRs an arrest is actually recorded, as a share of all cases
descriptions.officer_role_pair_overlap: how often the officer who registers an FIR is the same officer who then investigates it, or whether registration and investigation are handled by different officers
descriptions.incident_to_report_minutes_by_year: how quickly incidents are reported to the police, the time from incident to report, and whether people report as fast this year as in earlier years
descriptions.reporting_delay_count: how many cases record a reason for the complainant coming to the police late, some time after the incident
descriptions.weapon_statute_cooccurrence_by_year: in what kinds of cases weapons turn up, which legal sections weapon cases are charged under, and whether that has changed over the years
descriptions.statute_court_stage_join: on one side which legal sections cases are being registered under, and on the other side how far those cases have progressed in court
descriptions.fir_section_case_count: how many FIRs cite a particular legal section, such as the murder section, and the count of FIRs per section
descriptions.incident_time_of_day: at what time of day incidents happen: morning, afternoon, evening or night
descriptions.statute_mix_by_year: what kinds of cases we are dealing with now compared with a couple of years ago, the mix of legal sections by year
descriptions.gender_breakdown: the ratio of male to female among the named accused
descriptions.station_total_count: how many police stations there are in total
descriptions.filtered_fir_listing: which specific FIRs, with their numbers and status, match a given offence, statute, station or crime type
descriptions.top_districts_by: which district has the most cases, ranking districts by caseload
descriptions.weapon_recovery_rate_by_district: which district recovers the most weapons relative to its caseload, the weapon recovery rate per district
descriptions.graph_recurrence_person: a specific person who appears in more than one case, possibly in different roles: someone with an earlier case on record who has turned up again, been arrested more than once, or is wanted or under investigation in another matter
descriptions.graph_recurrence_vehicle: a car, motorcycle or other vehicle, identified by its registration plate, that turns up in more than one case
descriptions.graph_recurrence_weapon: a weapon that appears in more than one case
descriptions.total_accused_count: how many accused persons, suspects or offenders there are in total — a count of people, not of cases
descriptions.total_count: how many cases or FIRs there are in total, the overall number of registered cases
descriptions.case_listing: a plain list of all the cases
descriptions.station_or_category_counts: how many cases each police station handles, or how many cases fall in each crime category, and which station handles the most
descriptions.unsupported_officer: which officer is assigned to or handled a particular case
descriptions.unsupported_trend: a trend over time, month over month or year over year, in the rate of reporting or the rate of increase
descriptions.xgraph_named_entity_network: whether a particular phone number, CNIC number, organisation or named person appears in any other case or FIR, and what that entity is connected to across cases
descriptions.legal_norm_lookup: what the law, the rules or the police procedure say or require: the procedure for registering an FIR, what a section provides, what the police must do

How come nothing in our setup preserves the statements given by a witness or a suspect during questioning — should that count as a hole in the data?
Hamare nizam mein woh baatein kyun mehfooz nahi hotin jo koi gawah ya mulzim poochh gachh ke dauran kehta hai — kya ise data ki kami samjha jaye?
ہمارے نظام میں وہ باتیں کیوں محفوظ نہیں ہوتیں جو کوئی گواہ یا ملزم پوچھ گچھ کے دوران کہتا ہے — کیا اِسے ڈیٹا کی کمی سمجھا جائے؟
Is the person who opens a matter supposed under the rules to also be the one who takes it forward, or should those be two different postings — and what does our own record show?
Qanoon ke mutabiq jo afsar muamla kholta hai kya usi ne aage bhi barhana hota hai, ya yeh do alag zimmedariyan honi chahiyen — aur hamara apna record kya kehta hai?
قانون کے مطابق جو افسر معاملہ کھولتا ہے کیا اُسی نے آگے بھی بڑھانا ہوتا ہے، یا یہ دو الگ ذمہ داریاں ہونی چاہئیں — اور ہمارا اپنا ریکارڈ کیا کہتا ہے؟
Where the force holds articles connected to a matter, is there a laid-down standard for entering them and for finally getting rid of them — and does our goods register keep to it?
Jab police kisi muamle se juri cheezein apne qabze mein leti hai, kya un ke indraj aur aakhir mein unhein khatam karne ka koi tay shuda mayaar hai — aur kya hamara maal register us par chalta hai?
جب پولیس کسی معاملے سے جڑی چیزیں اپنے قبضے میں لیتی ہے، کیا اُن کے اندراج اور آخر میں اُنہیں ختم کرنے کا کوئی طے شدہ معیار ہے — اور کیا ہمارا مال رجسٹر اُس پر چلتا ہے؟
Where a matter involves harm done to a female, do the rules call for a different handling than usual — and if so, does our record show those added steps were in fact carried out?

Agar kisi muamle mein kisi khatoon ko nuqsan pohanchaya gaya ho, kya zabta mamool se hat kar kuch aur maangta hai — aur agar haan, to kya hamara record dikhata hai ke woh zaid iqdamaat waqai kiye gaye?
اگر کسی معاملے میں کسی خاتون کو نقصان پہنچایا گیا ہو، کیا ضابطہ معمول سے ہٹ کر کچھ اور مانگتا ہے — اور اگر ہاں، تو کیا ہمارا ریکارڈ دکھاتا ہے کہ وہ زائد اقدامات واقعی کیے گئے؟
Do the lab-procedure rules set out anything particular on the way seized arms must be dealt with before entry, and does our arms register note whether that was observed?
Kya lab ke zawabit mein is bare mein koi khaas hidayat hai ke zabt shuda asliha indraj se pehle kis tarah rakha jaye, aur kya hamara asliha register yeh likhta hai ke un par amal hua ya nahi?
کیا لیب کے ضوابط میں اِس بارے میں کوئی خاص ہدایت ہے کہ ضبط شدہ اسلحہ اندراج سے پہلے کس طرح رکھا جائے، اور کیا ہمارا اسلحہ رجسٹر یہ لکھتا ہے کہ اُن پر عمل ہوا یا نہیں؟
Where an enquiry runs long, do the rules oblige the force to put something before the judge ahead of finishing — and would our progress data tell us whether that happened?
Agar kisi muamle ki chhan been lambi ho jaye, kya zabta police par lazim karta hai ke mukammal hone se pehle adalat ko kuch pesh kare — aur kya hamara progress data batayega ke aisa hua ya nahi?
اگر کسی معاملے کی چھان بین لمبی ہو جائے، کیا ضابطہ پولیس پر لازم کرتا ہے کہ مکمل ہونے سے پہلے عدالت کو کچھ پیش کرے — اور کیا ہمارا پروگریس ڈیٹا بتائے گا کہ ایسا ہوا یا نہیں؟

Where a person passes away in circumstances that raise doubt, the force has to formally look into what caused it — is that captured anywhere in our setup, particularly given how many of our matters involve a death?

Agar kisi ki maut aisay halaat mein ho jo shak paida karein, to police ko wajah ki baqaida chhan been karni hoti hai — kya hamara nizam ise kahin likhta hai, khusoosan jab hamare bohat se muamlat mein maut shamil hai?
اگر کسی کی موت ایسے حالات میں ہو جو شک پیدا کریں، تو پولیس کو وجہ کی باقاعدہ چھان بین کرنی ہوتی ہے — کیا ہمارا نظام اِسے کہیں لکھتا ہے، خصوصاً جب ہمارے بہت سے معاملات میں موت شامل ہے؟
We had two people cheated through internet banking — did the force deal with both of their complaints in the same way on paper?
آن لائن بینکنگ فراڈ کے دو متاثرین کے معاملات کیا کاغذی کارروائی میں یکساں طور پر نمٹائے گئے؟
Put your crime-analyst hat on and tell me what in the pile of cases we have right now looks off or deserves a closer eye.
Aik crime analyst ki hesiyat se hamare mojooda cases ka jaiza lein aur bataen ke kya cheez ghair mamooli lagti hai ya nazar rakhne ke qabil hai.
Write a brief starter note for an officer who has just been posted here — what should they expect from the caseload as it stands?
یہاں نئے تعینات ہونے والے افسر کے لیے ایک مختصر تعارفی نوٹ لکھیں — انہیں موجودہ کیس لوڈ سے کیا توقع رکھنی چاہیے؟
